user.title: Zigbee Availability
user.description: Get notified when a ZHA Zigbee device stays unavailable longer than the timeout. A device counts as unavailable when all of its enabled entities are unavailable.

data.notify_recovery: Notify when a device comes back

data_description.timeout_minutes: How long a device must be unavailable before you are notified. This is added on top of ZHA's own unavailability timeout.
data_description.notify_targets: Notify services (for example notify.mobile_app_phone) or notify entities. Leave empty to rely on the persistent notification, the sensor or the events.
data_description.notify_recovery: Send a message when a device you were alerted about becomes available again.
data_description.persistent_notification: Keep a notification in Home Assistant listing all currently unavailable devices.
data_description.exclude_labels: Devices with any of these labels are not monitored. Entities with these labels are ignored when deciding whether their device is unavailable.

abort.zha_not_configured: The ZHA integration is not set up. Zigbee Availability currently supports ZHA only.
